title: EPAM Testing, DevOps, and Git
description: pytest, fixtures, mocking, integration/e2e tests, Docker, docker-compose, Git branching, rebasing, pull requests, GitHub Actions, and CI/CD pipelines.

lessons.title: Testing Strategy

lessons.explanation: Explain testing strategy through behavior, trade-offs, examples, and failure modes. Connect syntax to production code instead of reciting definitions.

questions.prompt: Why is pytest common in Python backend teams?
options: It provides simple tests, fixtures, and rich assertions
questions.answer: It provides simple tests, fixtures, and rich assertions
questions.explanation: pytest makes Python tests concise and supports reusable setup through fixtures.

concept_panel.title: pytest
concept_panel.explanation: pytest makes Python tests concise and supports reusable setup through fixtures.
concept_panel.practical_example: Use pytest to test a FastAPI service function and API route.
concept_panel.interview_insight: Interviewers usually ask this concept to evaluate whether you can work in standard Python testing workflows.

questions.prompt: What is a fixture best used for?
questions.explanation: Fixtures prepare test state such as temporary databases, clients, or fake dependencies.

concept_panel.title: Fixtures
concept_panel.explanation: Fixtures prepare test state such as temporary databases, clients, or fake dependencies.
concept_panel.practical_example: A `client` fixture creates a FastAPI TestClient.
concept_panel.interview_insight: Interviewers usually ask this concept to evaluate whether you write maintainable tests.

questions.explanation: Mocks replace external APIs, email providers, payment gateways, or nondeterministic services.

concept_panel.title: Mocking
concept_panel.explanation: Mocks replace external APIs, email providers, payment gateways, or nondeterministic services.
concept_panel.practical_example: Mock HubSpot API calls while testing connection logic.
concept_panel.interview_insight: Interviewers usually ask this concept to evaluate whether you isolate tests without hiding the behavior being tested.

questions.prompt: What does an integration test verify?
questions.explanation: Integration tests cover boundaries like API route plus database or service plus repository.

concept_panel.title: Integration Tests
concept_panel.explanation: Integration tests cover boundaries like API route plus database or service plus repository.
concept_panel.practical_example: POST /connect stores a validated database connection in a test database.
concept_panel.interview_insight: Interviewers usually ask this concept to evaluate whether you can test real application wiring.

questions.prompt: What does an E2E test focus on?
options: A user workflow through the system
questions.answer: A user workflow through the system
questions.explanation: End-to-end tests exercise the app like a user, usually with more cost and fewer cases.

concept_panel.title: End-to-End Tests
concept_panel.explanation: End-to-end tests exercise the app like a user, usually with more cost and fewer cases.
concept_panel.practical_example: Signup, connect data source, view dashboard.
concept_panel.interview_insight: Interviewers usually ask this concept to evaluate whether you understand test levels and trade-offs.

questions.prompt: What is the difference between image and container?
options: Image is the artifact; container is a running instance
questions.answer: Image is the artifact; container is a running instance
questions.explanation: A Dockerfile builds an image; Docker runs containers from that image.

concept_panel.title: Docker Images and Containers
concept_panel.explanation: A Dockerfile builds an image; Docker runs containers from that image.
concept_panel.practical_example: Build a Python 3.12 slim image then run uvicorn inside a container.
concept_panel.interview_insight: Interviewers usually ask this concept to evaluate whether you understand container basics.

questions.prompt: What should a Dockerfile make explicit?
questions.explanation: A Dockerfile describes a reproducible runtime image.

concept_panel.title: Dockerfile
concept_panel.explanation: A Dockerfile describes a reproducible runtime image.
concept_panel.practical_example: Install requirements.txt, copy backend, run uvicorn.
concept_panel.interview_insight: Interviewers usually ask this concept to evaluate whether you can package an app for deployment.

questions.explanation: Compose coordinates local containers such as app, database, Redis, and workers.

concept_panel.title: docker-compose
concept_panel.explanation: Compose coordinates local containers such as app, database, Redis, and workers.
concept_panel.practical_example: Run FastAPI plus PostgreSQL locally with one command.
concept_panel.interview_insight: Interviewers usually ask this concept to evaluate whether you can build realistic local environments.

questions.explanation: Branches let engineers collaborate without committing directly to main.

concept_panel.title: Git Branching
concept_panel.explanation: Branches let engineers collaborate without committing directly to main.
concept_panel.interview_insight: Interviewers usually ask this concept to evaluate whether you understand team workflow.

questions.prompt: What is a common reason to rebase?
options: Replay your branch on latest main for a cleaner history
questions.answer: Replay your branch on latest main for a cleaner history
questions.explanation: Rebasing rewrites branch history, so use it carefully and avoid rebasing shared branches without coordination.

concept_panel.title: Rebasing
concept_panel.explanation: Rebasing rewrites branch history, so use it carefully and avoid rebasing shared branches without coordination.
concept_panel.practical_example: Rebase a local feature branch before opening a PR.
concept_panel.interview_insight: Interviewers usually ask this concept to evaluate whether you understand Git history management.

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of a pull request?
options: Review, discuss, and validate a change before merge
questions.answer: Review, discuss, and validate a change before merge
questions.explanation: PRs create a collaboration and quality gate around code changes.

concept_panel.title: Pull Requests
concept_panel.explanation: PRs create a collaboration and quality gate around code changes.
concept_panel.practical_example: A PR includes tests, summary, and linked issue.
concept_panel.interview_insight: Interviewers usually ask this concept to evaluate whether you can work in professional team processes.

questions.prompt: What should a basic GitHub Actions pipeline do?
options: Install dependencies, run tests, and build before merge/deploy
questions.answer: Install dependencies, run tests, and build before merge/deploy
questions.explanation: CI validates changes automatically. CD deploys a known artifact after checks pass.

concept_panel.title: GitHub Actions and CI/CD
concept_panel.explanation: CI validates changes automatically. CD deploys a known artifact after checks pass.
concept_panel.practical_example: Run pytest and npm test on each pull request.
concept_panel.interview_insight: Interviewers usually ask this concept to evaluate whether you understand automated delivery safeguards.

coding_challenges.title: EPAM Testing, DevOps, and Git status classifier
coding_challenges.instructions: Implement classify_status_code(code: int) -> str. Return success for 200-299, redirect for 300-399, client_error for 400-499, server_error for 500-599, and unknown otherwise.
coding_challenges.explanation: The challenge reinforces deterministic branching, status-code categories, and local test execution.
